[Donald Trump](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donald_Trump), the 45th and 47th [president of the United States](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_the_United_States), made 19 international trips to 25 countries (in addition to visiting the [West Bank](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Bank)) during [his first presidency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_presidency_of_Donald_Trump), which began on [January 20, 2017](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_inauguration_of_Donald_Trump), and ended on [January 20, 2021](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inauguration_of_Joe_Biden). As of July 2026, Trump has made 12 international trips to 17 countries during [his second presidency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_presidency_of_Donald_Trump), which began on [January 20, 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_inauguration_of_Donald_Trump).

Due to the [COVID-19 pandemic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19_pandemic), he did not make any international trips between February 2020 and the end of his first presidency.

### First presidency (2017–2021)

The number of visits per country where President Trump traveled during his first presidency are:

- One: [Afghanistan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islamic_Republic_of_Afghanistan), [Argentina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Argentina), [Canada](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canada), [China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/China), [Finland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finland), [India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/India), [Iraq](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iraq), [Israel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Israel), [North Korea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_Korea), the [Philippines](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philippines), [Poland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poland), [Saudi Arabia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saudi_Arabia), [Singapore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Singapore), the [Vatican City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vatican_City), and the [West Bank](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Bank)

- Two: [Belgium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belgium), [Germany](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Germany), [Ireland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Republic_of_Ireland), [Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italy), [South Korea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Korea), [Switzerland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Switzerland), and [Vietnam](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vietnam)

[Donald Trump](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donald_Trump), the 45th and 47th [president of the United States](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_the_United_States), made 19 international trips to 25 countries (in addition to visiting the [West Bank](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Bank)) during [his first presidency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_presidency_of_Donald_Trump), which began on [January 20, 2017](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_inauguration_of_Donald_Trump), and ended on [January 20, 2021](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inauguration_of_Joe_Biden). As of July 2026, Trump has made 12 international trips to 17 countries during [his second presidency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_presidency_of_Donald_Trump), which began on [January 20, 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_inauguration_of_Donald_Trump).

Due to the [COVID-19 pandemic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19_pandemic), he did not make any international trips between February 2020 and the end of his first presidency.

### First presidency (2017–2021)
[[edit](/w/index.php?title=List_of_international_presidential_trips_made_by_Donald_Trump&action=edit&section=2)]

The number of visits per country where President Trump traveled during his first presidency are:

- One: [Afghanistan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islamic_Republic_of_Afghanistan), [Argentina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Argentina), [Canada](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canada), [China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/China), [Finland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finland), [India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/India), [Iraq](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iraq), [Israel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Israel), [North Korea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_Korea), the [Philippines](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philippines), [Poland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poland), [Saudi Arabia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saudi_Arabia), [Singapore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Singapore), the [Vatican City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vatican_City), and the [West Bank](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Bank)

- Two: [Belgium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belgium), [Germany](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Germany), [Ireland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Republic_of_Ireland), [Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italy), [South Korea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Korea), [Switzerland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Switzerland), and [Vietnam](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vietnam)

- Three: [Japan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japan) and the [United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom)

- Four: [France](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/France)

### Second presidency (2025–present)
[[edit](/w/index.php?title=List_of_international_presidential_trips_made_by_Donald_Trump&action=edit&section=3)]

The number of visits per country where President Trump traveled during his second presidency are:

Toured [Mahatma Gandhi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mahatma_Gandhi)'s [Sabarmati Ashram](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sabarmati_Ashram) and the [Taj Mahal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taj_Mahal).[[37]](#cite_note-37) Received a formal welcome from [President](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_India) [Ram Nath Kovind](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ram_Nath_Kovind) at the [Rashtrapati Bhavan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rashtrapati_Bhavan,_New_Delhi) Presidential Palace in New Delhi. Conducted a series of meetings with Modi and other government officials, as well as Indian business executives.[[38]](#cite_note-38)

 [United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom)
[Turnberry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turnberry,_South_Ayrshire) and [Aberdeenshire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aberdeenshire)
July 25–29

He met with European Commission president [Ursula von der Leyen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ursula_von_der_Leyen) and successfully reached a trade deal with the European Union. September 16–18

Visited tomb of Queen [Elizabeth II](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elizabeth_II) at the [King George VI Memorial Chapel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_George_VI_Memorial_Chapel) at [St George's Chapel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St_George).[[56]](#cite_note-56)[[57]](#cite_note-57)

 [Israel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Israel)
[Jerusalem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jerusalem)

 [Egypt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Egypt)

 [Qatar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qatar)

[Gyeongju](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gyeongju), [Busan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Busan)

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

This is a list of international presidential trips made by Joe Biden, the [46th](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_presidents_of_the_United_States) president of the United States. [Joe Biden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joe_Biden) made 21 international trips to 28 countries (in addition to visiting the [West Bank](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Bank)) during [his presidency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Presidency_of_Joe_Biden), which began on [January 20, 2021](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inauguration_of_Joe_Biden) and ended on [January 20, 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_inauguration_of_Donald_Trump). Due to the [COVID-19 pandemic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19_pandemic), Biden did not make any international trips between January and June 2021.

The number of visits per country where President Biden traveled are:

- One: [Angola](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angola), [Brazil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brazil), [Cambodia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cambodia), [Canada](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canada), [Cape Verde](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cape_Verde), [Egypt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Egypt), [Finland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finland), [France](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/France), [India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/India), [Indonesia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indonesia), [Ireland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ireland), [Lithuania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lithuania), [Mexico](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mexico), [Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peru), [Saudi Arabia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saudi_Arabia), [South Korea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Korea), [Spain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spain), [Switzerland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Switzerland), [Ukraine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ukraine), [Vatican City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vatican_City), [Vietnam](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vietnam) and the [West Bank](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Bank)

- Two: [Belgium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belgium), [Germany](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Germany), [Israel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Israel), [Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italy), [Japan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japan) and [Poland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poland)

- Six: The [United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom)

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

This is a list of international presidential trips made by Joe Biden, the [46th](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_presidents_of_the_United_States) president of the United States. [Joe Biden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joe_Biden) made 21 international trips to 28 countries (in addition to visiting the [West Bank](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Bank)) during [his presidency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Presidency_of_Joe_Biden), which began on [January 20, 2021](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inauguration_of_Joe_Biden) and ended on [January 20, 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_inauguration_of_Donald_Trump). Due to the [COVID-19 pandemic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19_pandemic), Biden did not make any international trips between January and June 2021.

The number of visits per country where President Biden traveled are:

- One: [Angola](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angola), [Brazil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brazil), [Cambodia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cambodia), [Canada](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canada), [Cape Verde](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cape_Verde), [Egypt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Egypt), [Finland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finland), [France](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/France), [India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/India), [Indonesia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indonesia), [Ireland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ireland), [Lithuania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lithuania), [Mexico](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mexico), [Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peru), [Saudi Arabia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saudi_Arabia), [South Korea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Korea), [Spain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spain), [Switzerland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Switzerland), [Ukraine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ukraine), [Vatican City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vatican_City), [Vietnam](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vietnam) and the [West Bank](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Bank)

- Two: [Belgium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belgium), [Germany](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Germany), [Israel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Israel), [Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italy), [Japan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japan) and [Poland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poland)

- Six: The [United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom)

 United Kingdom
[Mildenhall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mildenhall,_Suffolk), [St Ives](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St_Ives,_Cornwall), [Bodelva](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bodelva), [Windsor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windsor,_Berkshire)
June 9–13
Attended the [47th G7 summit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/47th_G7_summit) at the [Carbis Bay Hotel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carbis_Bay_Hotel). Met with [Queen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monarchy_of_the_United_Kingdom) [Elizabeth II](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elizabeth_II) at [Windsor Castle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windsor_Castle) and Prime Minister [Boris Johnson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boris_Johnson). Both Biden and Johnson issued a revision of the [Atlantic Charter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Atlantic_Charter) which had previously been issued by their predecessors, [Franklin Roosevelt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Franklin_Roosevelt) and [Winston Churchill](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Winston_Churchill) respectively, eighty years prior.[[1]](#cite_note-1)[[2]](#cite_note-2) Participated in a meeting with the [G7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Group_of_Seven) leaders and other members of the [Royal Family](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/British_royal_family) at [Eden Project](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eden_Project) in Bodelva. Also met with [US Air Force](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Air_Force) personnel at [RAF Mildenhall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RAF_Mildenhall). Stayed at [Tregenna Castle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tregenna_Castle).[[3]](#cite_note-foreign_trip_13-3)[[4]](#cite_note-4)
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Family_photo_of_the_G7_leaders_at_Carbis_Bay_(1).jpg

 Belgium
[Brussels](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brussels)
June 13–15
Attended the [31st NATO summit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2021_Brussels_NATO_summit). Met with [King](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monarchy_of_Belgium) [Philippe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philippe_of_Belgium) and Prime Minister [Alexander De Croo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexander_De_Croo) at the [Royal Palace of Brussels](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_Palace_of_Brussels). Held multilateral meetings with the leaders of the [Baltic states](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baltic_states), [Secretary General of NATO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Secretary_General_of_NATO) [Jens Stoltenberg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jens_Stoltenberg), and Turkish president [Recep Erdoğan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Recep_Tayyip_Erdoğan).[[5]](#cite_note-foreign_trip_122-5) Also participated in an EU–US summit with European Council president [Charles Michel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charles_Michel) and European Commission president [Ursula von der Leyen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ursula_von_der_Leyen) at the [Europa building](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Europa_building). Stayed at the [US Embassy in Brussels](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belgium–United_States_relations#Resident_diplomatic_missions).[[6]](#cite_note-6)
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:P20210615AS-0600_(51267682502).jpg

  Switzerland
[Geneva](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geneva)
June 15–16
Attended the [summit meeting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2021_Russia–United_States_Summit) with Russian president [Vladimir Putin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vladimir_Putin) at [Villa La Grange](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parc_La_Grange). Held a bilateral meeting with Swiss president [Guy Parmelin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guy_Parmelin) and Swiss foreign minister [Ignazio Cassis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ignazio_Cassis) at the [InterContinental Geneva](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/InterContinental_Geneva), where he stayed.[[7]](#cite_note-7)
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Putin_in_Switzerland_2021_10.jpg

 Vatican City
Vatican City
October 29
Met with [Pope Francis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pope_Francis) at the [Apostolic Palace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apostolic_Palace). Also held bilateral meeting with [Cardinal Secretary of State](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cardinal_Secretary_of_State) [Pietro Parolin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pietro_Parolin).[[8]](#cite_note-8)
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Joe_Biden_met_with_Pope_Francis_again_at_the_Vatican_-_2021.jpg

 Italy
[Rome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rome)
October 29 – November 1
Met with Italian president [Sergio Mattarella](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sergio_Mattarella) at [Quirinale Palace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quirinale_Palace), Italian prime minister [Mario Draghi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mario_Draghi) at [Chigi Palace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chigi_Palace), and French president [Emmanuel Macron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emmanuel_Macron) at the Embassy of France. On October 30, attended the [G20 summit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2021_G20_Rome_summit) at La Nuvola in Rome. Met with Italian prime minister [Mario Draghi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mario_Draghi), took the customary photo with other world leaders, and attended an event on supporting women-owned businesses. Met with British prime minister [Boris Johnson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boris_Johnson), French president [Emmanuel Macron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emmanuel_Macron), and outgoing [German Chancellor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chancellor_of_Germany) [Angela Merkel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angela_Merkel). On October 31, Also held bilateral meeting with Turkish president [Recep Tayyip Erdoğan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Recep_Tayyip_Erdoğan).[[9]](#cite_note-9)
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Family_photo_G20_Italy_2021.jpg

 United Kingdom
[Glasgow](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glasgow)
November 1–2
Attended [COP26](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COP26) at the [Scottish Event Campus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SEC_Centre). Met with British prime minister [Boris Johnson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boris_Johnson), [First Minister of Scotland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_Minister_of_Scotland) [Nicola Sturgeon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nicola_Sturgeon), and [UN Secretary-General](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Secretary-General_of_the_United_Nations) [António Guterres](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/António_Guterres). Also held a bilateral meeting with Indonesian president [Joko Widodo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joko_Widodo).[[10]](#cite_note-10)
